courseStyle: Municipal public · open, flatter front nine; tighter, tree-lined, hilly back nine

verification.version: Municipal scorecard 22–23, published August 2022; current attachment accessed 2026-10-29
verification.note: Scorecard values used consistently. Orange printed back/total disagree with its individual holes and is not playable until clarified.

mission: Build your round around clear approaches. The front nine is more open; keep extra room for error on the tighter, hillier back nine.
gamePlan: Use your stock distances to choose a comfortable next shot, then confirm the landing area from the tee. Yardage alone cannot tell us where a dogleg turns.
Play to the middle until you can see the pin and trouble. The course has two double-dogleg par fives; choose each landing area from what you can actually see.
Get back to a clear line rather than trying to make up every yard. A simple recovery keeps the next shot manageable.
The printed card identifies the driving range left of Hole 9 and right of Hole 18 as out of bounds. Check current stakes and local rules on arrival.
